description:
Get step-by-step installation instructions for a skill on a specific platform. / 플랫폼별 스킬 설치 가이드.

    Args:
        skill_id: 스킬 ID
        platform: 플랫폼 이름 - 'OpenClaw' | 'ClaudeCode' | 'ClaudeCodeAgentSkill' | 'CustomAgent' | 'Cursor' | 'GeminiCLI' | 'CodexCLI'

    Returns:
        단계별 설치 가이드 문자열

platform.description: Platform to get installation steps for, one of: OpenClaw | ClaudeCode | ClaudeCodeAgentSkill | CodexCLI | Cursor | GeminiCLI | CustomAgent. Default OpenClaw.
platform.title: Platform

skill_id.description: Skill UUID as returned by search_skills in the [...] prefix of each result, e.g. 4bda3fb4-8d5c-4387-bd9f-47d75570b56a.
skill_id.title: Skill Id

name: get_install_guide
